---
title: "Hackathon"
author: "The Missing Third"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
hackathon_data <- read.csv("C:/Users/fearo/OneDrive/Documents/GitHub/nyc_access_clean.csv")
library(stargazer)
```

```{r reg, include=FALSE}
regression <- lm(log_access ~ population + poverty_pct + youth_pct + older_pct + log_density + log_income, data = hackathon_data)
```

```{r our table, include=FALSE}
summary(regression)
```

```{r stargazer table, results='asis', echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
cat('<div style="display: flex; justify-content: center;">')
stargazer(regression, 
          type = "html",                  
          title = "Regression Results: Access",
          dep.var.labels = "Logged Access",
          covariate.labels = c("Population", "Poverty Percentage", "Youth Percentage", "Older Percentage", "Log of Density", "Log of Income"),
          align = TRUE,                   # Align coefficients vertically
          no.space = TRUE)                # Removes empty lines to make it compact
```
